preamble: De-retroflexion of the voiceless retroflex affricate [ʈʂ] to alveolar [ts] merges the retroflex and dental sibilant series. It is pervasive in colloquial Taiwanese Mandarin and is the hallmark of mazurzenie in Polish dialects, where cz merged with c (Old Polish czudo > standard cudo 'marvel').

examples.note: Retroflex zh-, ch-, sh- merge into alveolar z-, c-, s- in everyday speech; nonstandard but extremely common among all speakers in Taiwan.
Mazurzenie: the postalveolar (retroflex) sibilants merged completely with the dentialveolars in Masovian and Lesser Polish dialects.
A mazurated form that entered the literary standard; likewise czeber > ceber 'bucket'.
